how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application format from the notice board of the district office, Janpad office or Gram Panchayat, or from www.sukma.gov.in.
Fill the form with a self-attested latest photograph and the self-attested certificates and marksheets.
Attach two blank self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 postage stamps each.
Write the name of the post applied for / cadre clearly on the envelope.
Send by closed registered post / speed post only, addressed to the Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Chhindgarh.
Applications must reach between 25-11-2026 and 10-12-2026 by 5:30 PM on office days.
important_instructions: If no eligible application comes from a Gram Panchayat, a candidate of the same category from the Janpad Panchayat will be selected by merit Where marksheet shows only a grade, the average percentage of that grade will be given Incomplete, unclear or incorrect applications will be rejected without separate intimation

content_sections.heading: How Will Janpad Panchayat Chhindgarh Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list prepared Gram Panchayat-wise from applications received (70 marks for qualification, 15 for experience, 15 for diploma/certificate or Panchayat-cum-DEO experience) List of candidates after scrutiny displayed on the Janpad Panchayat notice board for claims and objections 70 marks: weightage of marks obtained in the minimum qualification 15 marks: experience in government rural development schemes - 5 marks for 6 months, 1 mark for each further 6 months, maximum 15 Tie broken by age: older candidate selected first Waiting list of 10 names valid for 1 year

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested native resident certificate of the same Gram Panchayat Permanent caste certificate and permanent resident certificate (reserved posts) Degree / provisional degree / marksheets, self-attested, including back page of marksheet Experience certificate with appointment order (for experience marks) NOC through proper channel if employed; medical board certificate for disabled candidates Latest passport size photograph and two self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 stamps

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Janpad Panchayat Chhindgarh Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application format from the notice board of the district office, Janpad office or Gram Panchayat, or from www.sukma.gov.in. Fill the form with a self-attested latest photograph and the self-attested certificates and marksheets. Attach two blank self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 postage stamps each. Write the name of the post applied for / cadre clearly on the envelope. Send by closed registered post / speed post only, addressed to the Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Chhindgarh. Applications must reach between 25-11-2026 and 10-12-2026 by 5:30 PM on office days.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: If no eligible application comes from a Gram Panchayat, a candidate of the same category from the Janpad Panchayat will be selected by merit Where marksheet shows only a grade, the average percentage of that grade will be given Incomplete, unclear or incorrect applications will be rejected without separate intimation

faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Janpad Panchayat Chhindgarh Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC) and resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat; for Bastar and Surguja divisions the priority order is 12th pass, 10th pass, 8th pass. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. 100 percent disability not accepted as the posts are for field work. Employees of government / semi-government / non-government bodies must apply through proper channel with an NOC.

Persons married to someone with a living spouse, unless exempted by government order and court order. Persons with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 28 February 2001.
